macro.overnight_read: Bitcoin is sliding below $77,000 alongside crypto liquidations and heavy ETF outflows, while VIX sits elevated at 21.63 and put/call ratios flash caution at 1.54 ahead of U.S. midterms.
macro.summary: Markets are defensive as tech and crypto face strong downward pressure, evidenced by lagging sectors like SMH and XLK. Investors are rotating into defensive havens and stable domestic leaders like XLP and XLV while keeping dry powder for a packed macroeconomic data calendar starting with JOLTS.
